question: Contrast how long Rossell Seed Library and Lenwick Canal Transit keep records and what requires keeping them longer.

ui.answer:
[1] Rossell Seed Library accession records are retained for 7 years, unless a quarantine investigation requires longer retention.

[2] Lenwick Canal Transit voyage logs are retained for 3 years, unless a navigation inquiry requires longer retention.
